items.name: Generic AA quartz movement, 14 mm shaft, 56 x 56 x 17 mm class
items.description: User shaft length 14 mm; reference housing envelope 56 x 56 x 17 mm. Selected design cavity 64 x 64 x 20.4 mm. Supplied washer and shaft nut retain 2.4 mm dial. Thread length and hand press-fit sizes need physical fit check.

supply_risks: Movement STEP unavailable; cavity uses published common housing envelope, not an exact asset fit check.
14 mm total shaft does not specify threaded length; confirm nut engages on the 2.4 mm dial with supplied washer before final assembly.
User states 90 mm maximum; image labels minute hand 102 mm. Flat radius 108 mm accommodates both.
Raised marks require hand underside at least 1.1 mm above the flat dial for a nominal 0.5 mm running gap; 14 mm total shaft length alone does not prove this clearance.
